For Stick Fiddler: complete all four stages. 1) Board: hit flat pieces with towers; first board bottom-left up, middle down, top-right down. 2) Phone: gather one digit per calendar day Oct 11,14,20,23,27,30 (clues vary: Morse lamp, painting, record, clock, phone rings etc.), dial in date order then #. 3) Bridge: follow poem order; gold=trophy, heat=brazier, moon=sculpture, water=fountain, sun=sundial, earth=soil, forest/rest=tree. Ignore Eternal March heading. Three errors reset. 4) Lighthouse: choose door farthest from figure(s), avoid out-of-order doors; layout varies. The Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui also prompts a play.
